title: Environmental Ledger
negative_results: Synthetic environmental channels are SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION, not physical measurements; the REAL-mode ledger is BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT because no sensor was operated.
A residual within the combined quadrature uncertainty is not anomalous (is_within_budget) and refuse_subbudget_as_anomaly always raises; no anomaly, signal, or new effect is claimed.
A manual declaration is a SOURCE_CLAIM with the lowest source authority and cannot substitute for a sensor trace (refuse_manual_as_sensor); authoritative() prefers the sensor trace.
A run missing a required environmental channel is invalidated (INVALIDATE) or degraded (DEGRADE); a complete synthetic ledger reaches at most E2 and never the physical level E4.
reopening_test: Re-run pytest tests/v8/test_environment.py. The phase reopens if a synthetic channel stops being deterministic under its seed, a within-budget residual is reported as anomalous, a manual declaration gains authority over a sensor trace, a missing required channel no longer invalidates the run, the error budget stops combining in quadrature or drifts out of conformance with error_budget.schema.json, or any channel claims a class stronger than SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION without real artifacts.
acceptance_checklist: Required output r15/environment.py implemented (nine nuisance channels; REAL/REPLAY/SYNTHETIC/FAULT_INJECTION modes distinct).
Required output tests/v8/test_environment.py implemented; 31 focused, negative, and determinism tests green.
Terminal receipt docs/v8/receipts/P03.json conforms to r15/schemas/phase_receipt.schema.json (validated with jsonschema).
Synthetic drift appears in drift_rate output (required test).
Clock misalignment is detected via clock offset and cross-correlation lag (required test).
Missing required environment invalidates the run (required test).
Manual declarations have lower authority than sensor traces (required test).
Error budget decomposes into eleven components and combines in quadrature per error_budget.schema.json.
is_within_budget and refuse_subbudget_as_anomaly implemented; a sub-budget residual is not anomalous.
Synthetic channels deterministic under a seed; timestamps passed in, never wall-clock.
Imports r15.claims; reuses r13.daq; no sibling r15 phase module hard-imported.
environment_report() returns claim_class, measured_here=nothing, physical_validation, verdict.
Privacy scan clean: synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs.

claims.statement: An environmental ledger records ambient nuisance conditions as hashed, clock-aligned synthetic time-series channels and feeds an eleven-component quadrature error budget.
Synthetic environmental channels are deterministic observations, not measurements; the strongest class reached is SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION at evidence E2.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
